sources.title: OpenAI Codex (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: OpenAI Codex is a large language model developed by OpenAI for translating natural-language prompts into source code. Announced in 2021, it was a modified production version of GPT-3 that was fine-tuned on source code in multiple programming languages, and it served as the original model for GitHub Copilot. sources.title: MLX (machine learning framework) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: MLX is an open-source machine learning framework developed by Apple and designed primarily for Apple silicon. It is used for training and running machine learning models and is optimized for Apple silicon's unified memory architecture, allowing the CPU and GPU to work with the same data without copying it between separate memory pools.
